productMaturity: B1-internal-complete-validation-only; not a published long-term save contract

semanticSeed.parserBoundary: G2 test/research target only; production compiler, writer and features must not depend on or parse this JSON

testParser.numberRule: deserialize every seed geometry/scalar number directly into its declared Rust f64, u32, i32 or u64 destination type; no decimal normalization layer
testParser.duplicateAndUnknownRule: the test-only seed DTO uses deny_unknown_fields and rejects duplicate logical fields before mapping

semanticSeed.moduleSelection: the five modules array entries in physical index order 0 through 4
semanticSeed.embeddedDocumentRule: parse each modules[i].source as the exact old research Geometry JSON document; modules[i].sourcePath is evidence metadata only

moduleHeaderRule.imports: the incoming importEdges entry for moduleKeys[i], or the empty vector for p100.m00
moduleHeaderRule.randomSeed: present OptionalU64 with value equal to zero-based module index i
moduleHeaderRule.description: ASCII 'LF-ROAD-EDITING-P100-v1 module ' followed by two-digit zero-padded i
parametersAndInputsDigestPreimage: the 32 raw bytes decoded from semanticSeed.sha256
frontendOptionsDigestPreimage: geometry approximation semantics fixed code DeterministicTargetV1 = 1 as one u8
geometry accuracy profile numeric code as one u8
geometry direction profile numeric code as one u8
moduleHeaderRule.digestAlgorithm: SHA-256 over the listed byte parts without separators beyond the stated U+0000

semanticMapping.moduleRule: semantic seed module i maps to exactly one RoadEditingSource module i; old namespace, document key, imports and provenance are replaced only by moduleHeaderRule
semanticMapping.roadRule: every seed roads[] entry maps to one RoadAlignment keyed by roadKey and one RoadCorridor keyed by its sole crossSectionSpans[0].corridorKey; frame, reference curve, station interval, reference section/lane and ordered elements are preserved
semanticMapping.crossSectionRule: nested roadSections, lanes, laneGroups and facilityBands are promoted one-for-one to their corresponding stable root tables; all seed keys, kind IDs, directions, references, speeds and ordered/set-like relationships are preserved
semanticMapping.laneEdgeRule: every seed lane maps its laneEdgeKey to one section-derived LaneEdge; every junction.internalEdges[] entry maps its laneEdgeKey to one junction-internal LaneEdge with its exact explicit curve; no other LaneEdge is generated
semanticMapping.junctionRule: every seed junction maps one-for-one; approachEdges and internalEdges preserve their member sets; every connections[] entry maps one Movement and one ManeuverPath using movementKey, junctionKey, directed approach keys, maneuverPathKey, entryEdge, ordered internalEdgeSequence and exitEdge exactly
semanticMapping.remainingStableTablesRule: seed overlays.stopLines, maneuverGates, waitingZones, signalGroups, signalControllers, each signalControllers[].phases entry, parkingAreas, parkingSpaces, participantClasses, accessRules, vehicleProfiles, staticRoutes and root frames map one-for-one to same-semantic v1 tables with all scalar, string, enum, optional and ordered values preserved except rules explicitly overridden below; equal signalPhaseKey values under different controllers remain equal sibling-local keys and are not renamed
semanticMapping.curveRule: all seed line/cubic segment kinds, start/end/control coordinates and segment order are preserved bit-for-bit as parsed binary64 values; roads create alignment CurvePrograms and junction internal edges create explicit CurvePrograms
semanticMapping.referenceRule: the synthetic import chain adds no cross-module entity reference; module-scoped targets use local-key, while owner-scoped targets use the exact current-module chain owner-key>...>local-key with no namespace prefix; the chain is derived from the explicit owner rules below and every segment preserves the seed key
semanticMapping.identityOwnerRule: all identity owner trees are module-local; synthesize and mutually validate RoadSection.road_corridor, AuthoringLane.road_section, Movement.junction, ManeuverPath.movement, ManeuverGate.maneuver_path, WaitingZone.maneuver_path, SignalPhase.signal_controller, LaneGroup.road_section and FacilityBand.road_corridor; RoadCorridor.elements, RoadSection.authoring_lanes and SignalController.signal_phases must name the same children in their preserved semantic order

specialFieldMapping.corridorEndNumber: StationEndKind.Finite with end_station_meters equal to the parsed seed number
specialFieldMapping.gateSignalControlString: SignalControlKind.SignalGroup with signal_group equal to the seed string
specialFieldMapping.accessTarget: target.kind selects target_kind and the same object's sole kind-named string selects target_reference
specialFieldMapping.laneSuccessors: copy to LaneEdge.successors; all lanes naming the same edge must provide the same values
specialFieldMapping.signalDuration: seed durationSeconds multiplied by exactly 1000.0 in binary64, required integral, then checked-converted to u64 duration_milliseconds
specialFieldMapping.signalOffset: seed offsetSeconds multiplied by exactly 1000.0 in binary64, required integral, then checked-converted to u64 offset_milliseconds
specialFieldMapping.ownerReferenceEncoding: encode the root-to-target seed key tuple with one ASCII > byte between adjacent keys and no namespace prefix; every owner-defining field uses the root-to-parent tuple, while owner vectors and other references use the root-to-target tuple required by the target kind

semanticMapping.rootVectorOrder: RoadAlignment and module-scoped identity kinds use local-key UTF-8 bytes ascending; owner-scoped kinds use full owner-key tuple then local-key, comparing each UTF-8 byte segment lexicographically without concatenation
semanticMapping.unorderedReferenceOrder: normalized parsed namespace, owner-key tuple and local-key ascending
semanticMapping.sourceAddressUniqueness: RoadAlignment and module-scoped kind keys are unique within a module; owner-scoped keys are unique only among siblings under the same direct owner, so equal SignalPhase local keys under the two different controllers in each module are valid and produce different full source addresses

widthProfileRule.memberSet: all 170 AuthoringLane and 35 FacilityBand declarations across the five generated modules
widthProfileRule.baseWidth: the seed widthMeters of the mapped lane or facility band
widthProfileRule.candidateMemberRule: a member is eligible for a non-constant profile only when its containing RoadCorridor is listed under junctionConnectedEnd or junctionConnectedStart; the named endpoint is the sole endpoint used by a Junction approach edge and must retain baseWidth
widthProfileRule.rewriteTargetExclusion: p100.m02 AuthoringLane section-main-w2e-road-0/lane/2 must remain constant and is excluded from every non-constant candidate list
widthProfileRule.sortOrder: eligible members after rewriteTargetExclusion, module index ascending, AuthoringLane before FacilityBand, then local key UTF-8 bytes ascending
widthProfileRule.moderateProfileSelection: take zero-based sorted eligible ordinals 0 through 19; even ordinals are wideningPositive and odd ordinals are narrowingPositive

assignments.selection: after removing moderateProfileSelection, retain the same sort order, filter to FacilityBand members in junctionConnectedEnd, and take the first 5
after removing moderateProfileSelection, retain the same sort order, filter to FacilityBand members in junctionConnectedStart, and take the first 5

widthProfileRule.selectionDisjointness: the four selections are pairwise disjoint and contain exactly 10, 10, 5 and 5 members respectively
widthProfileRule.junctionJoinInvariant: for every member in a corridor with a Junction-connected endpoint, its width at that endpoint equals the seed baseWidth bit-for-bit; zero-width endpoints are restricted to FacilityBand members so the shortest-corridor cumulative offset slope remains below the Smooth1Deg join budget; no width rewrite moves a section-derived LaneEdge endpoint relative to the preserved junction-internal explicit curves
widthProfileRule.constantRule: every other member, including rewriteTargetExclusion, uses start = baseWidth and end = baseWidth
widthProfileRule.arithmetic: IEEE 754 binary64 round-to-nearest ties-to-even; each multiplication by 0.75 or 1.25 is one rounded operation

optionalFieldRule.canvasSelectionPresence: present on every table that declares canvas_selection, including every CurveSegment
optionalFieldRule.curveProgramOrdinalRule: within each module, alignments in canonical alignment order first, followed by junction-internal LaneEdge explicit programs in canonical LaneEdge order; zero-based three-digit ordinals
optionalFieldRule.canvasSelectionUniqueness: all generated canvas_selection values are pairwise unique within one module and every value is within max_single_string_bytes=53; these compact workload-only opaque keys do not define a general editor display label
optionalFieldRule.seedOptionalFields: lane group, parking area, participant parent, signal group and every other seed optional preserve present/absent state
optionalFieldRule.accessRegulationSelection: sort all AccessRule values by module index then access_rule_key UTF-8 bytes; zero-based even ordinals have regulation present and odd ordinals have it absent

generatorContract.profileGenerationRule: generate the same five semantic modules independently for every one of the nine profileMatrix combinations under DeterministicTargetV1; source buffers vary only through root profile codes, provenance.frontend_options_digest and their deterministic FlatBuffers encoding, while compiled LIR point payload may additionally vary by profile

profileMatrix.enumerationOrder: accuracy profile outer loop numeric ascending, direction profile inner loop numeric ascending

horizontalRegularityResourceProbe.role: formal five-module companion resource workload; exercises the production curved-offset path without mutating semanticSeed
horizontalRegularityResourceProbe.baseWorkload: generate the complete LF-ROAD-EDITING-P100-v1 five-module source exactly, then apply the one replacement below before writer encoding

replacement.endpointAndJoinRule: start and end exactly equal the replaced line; control2 has the same z as the end, so the connected end tangent remains +X and the existing junction join direction is preserved; topology endpoints and every declaration/reference/count remain unchanged
replacement.widthRule: retain the base workload widthProfileRule assignments; this alignment therefore includes inner/outer offsets and widening/narrowing lane profiles while every member retains seed baseWidth at the connected junction end

horizontalRegularityResourceProbe.countInheritanceRule: all exactCounts, perModuleCounts and tableOccurrenceAccounting values not explicitly overridden above remain identical to the base workload; in particular total table occurrences remain 3165 and canvas selection occurrences remain 2025

horizontalRegularityVisitExpectation.accountingRule: count each cubic regularity DFS pop once, cache by RoadAlignment source segment across all derived lane/facility offsets, and do not count direct line checks or junction-internal explicit curves

horizontalRegularityResourceProbe.measurementRule: use Fine2Cm plus Smooth1Deg and the same release/locked reference machine, one warmup, seven fresh formal processes, named stage timing, live-byte ledger and retained-capacity protocol as the main workload; retain the probe module digests and byte lengths separately
horizontalRegularityResourceProbe.resourceMonotonicityRule: for this identical source and deterministic midpoint tree, Fine2Cm/Smooth1Deg has a subset acceptance predicate relative to every looser supported profile and is the required curved-offset point-count/CPU/scratch/live resource upper case; the probe is invalid if Fine2Cm/Smooth1Deg does not complete successfully
horizontalRegularityResourceProbe.peakRelationship: the probe complete-compile CPU/scratch/live-byte peak is coequal formal absolute-budget evidence and must independently fit the same production limits; it neither replaces the main nine-combination P100 evidence nor adds its separate-process peak arithmetically to the main peak

offlineGeometryObservation.intervalRule: each uninterrupted source-segment and reference-station-row evaluator interval independently, including both endpoints
offlineGeometryObservation.combinationAggregationRule: for each of the nine profile combinations, aggregate all samples from all five modules; enumerate canonical module order, then RoadAlignment followed by section-derived lane/facility offsets and junction-internal LaneEdge source-address order, then evaluator-interval ordinal, then k ascending; shared interval endpoints remain separate occurrences
offlineGeometryObservation.parameterRule: for interval [ta,tb] and integer k=0..4096, convert k exactly to binary64, compute fraction=k/4096.0, then t=ta+(tb-ta)*fraction with subtract, divide, multiply and add rounded in that order; k=4096 uses the stored tb exactly
offlineGeometryObservation.parameterAssociatedSegmentRule: within the currently observed evaluator interval, retain that interval's final polyline vertex parameters and choose the smallest interval-local final segment index j whose parameter end is >= t; an internal shared vertex belongs to the preceding segment, while the separately observed start of the next evaluator interval uses that next interval's segment 0
offlineGeometryObservation.distanceRule: lift the selected f32 segment endpoints Q0/Q1 exactly to binary64; compute v=Q1-Q0 and w=P-Q0 by x/y/z; vv=(vx*vx+vy*vy)+vz*vz; if vv==0 use u=0, otherwise r=((wx*vx+wy*vy)+wz*vz)/vv and clamp with r<=0 => u=0, r>=1 => u=1, else u=r; compute C=Q0+u*v by component, delta=P-C, distanceSquared=(dx*dx+dy*dy)+dz*dz, then distance=sqrt(distanceSquared); every operator rounds once to nearest ties-to-even, -0 normalizes to +0, and FMA, mul_add and pow/powi are forbidden; any non-finite value invalidates the sample set
offlineGeometryObservation.statisticsPopulation: the complete aggregate sample occurrence sequence for one profile combination, including repeated boundary occurrences
offlineGeometryObservation.percentileRule: sort all finite nonnegative binary64 distance values ascending; for p in 50,95,99 select zero-based rank ceil(p*N/100)-1, computed as ((p*N+99)/100)-1 with checked integers; maximum is the final sorted value; equal maximum values attribute to the earliest sample in combinationAggregationRule order
offlineGeometryObservation.completenessRule: record evaluatorIntervalCount and sampleCount for each profile combination; require sampleCount = checked_mul(evaluatorIntervalCount,4097), and require the validator's independently enumerated canonical interval identities to match one-for-one before accepting statistics
offlineGeometryObservation.attributionRule: record module, full owner-qualified source address, source segment/station-row ordinal and parameter for the maximum observed value
offlineGeometryObservation.interpretation: observed engineering evidence only; samples between grid points are not covered and no value may be described as a continuous hard bound

singleModuleRewriteScenario.connectionInvariant: the edited lane belongs to corridor-main-road-0 whose Junction-connected endpoint is end; candidate endWidthMeters remains the seed 3.5 and complete candidate compilation must not emit a join diagnostic
lifecycle: retain all five accepted source buffers
retain the old p100.m02 buffer while building the candidate typed model
encode and retain the new p100.m02 buffer
compile the candidate import closure while old accepted revision remains live
on success atomically replace p100.m02 and then release its old buffer

toolchain.measurementSubcommandRule: G2 adds a road-editing-p100 subcommand whose complete per-sample argv, profile codes, sample index and repository-relative output path are retained in evidence; the cargoArguments array is the exact executable-selection prefix

measurementProtocol.processIsolation: one fresh process for the warmup and each formal sample; no benchmark concurrency
measurementProtocol.primaryStatistic: median of the seven formal samples
measurementProtocol.dispersionStatistic: median absolute deviation of the same seven samples
measurementProtocol.timingBoundary: semantic seed file read and harness deserialization occur before timing; each named stage times only that production operation; complete-compile begins immediately before RoadEditingModuleInput admission and ends after validated compilation output is returned
measurementProtocol.memoryBoundary: report the compiler-controlled live-byte ledger at every named phase boundary and its maximum; OS RSS is supplemental and cannot replace the ledger
measurementProtocol.environmentRule: AC power and the reference machine's recorded Balanced power plan; do not override process affinity; capture OS build, firmware, CPU, memory, rustc, LLVM, power state and complete argv in evidence
measurementProtocol.retentionRule: retain every raw sample, phase ledger, generated module digest, byte length, table occurrence count, geometry point count, observed position-error distribution, worst-case attribution and final direction-jump maximum
